name: Luchi
steps: Mix maida with a pinch of sugar and salt.
Add ghee and rub into the flour.
Add water to make soft, smooth dough.
Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide into small balls.
Roll each ball into thin circles.
Heat oil in a deep pan.
Gently slide luchi into hot oil.
Press gently with ladle to puff up.
Fry until light golden.
Drain on paper.
Serve hot with aloo dum or cholar dal.

name: Bhapa Ilish
steps: Marinate fish pieces with turmeric and salt.
Grind mustard seeds with green chillies to paste.
Mix mustard paste with mustard oil.
Add grated coconut to the mixture.
Coat fish pieces with this mixture.
Place in a steamer bowl.
Steam for 15-20 minutes.
Check if fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
